_comment: R0 plant model for bag replay. Code-derived, not fitted: this bag has only 775/14191 steady-state samples and vy is barely excited.
v_gain_note: weak fit in bag (slope 0.637, corr 0.52, vx only); bracketed by earlier X-stage 0.44-0.64
wz_gain_note: exact from code: comm injects 0.01 rad/s per RC count, chassis_yaw_hold applies CHASSIS_YAW_HOLD_RC_SEN=0.0052
deadband_v_note: CHASSIS_RC_DEADLINE=25 counts * CHASSIS_VX_RC_SEN=0.005625 m/s per count
deadband_frame_note: host rotates (vx,vy) by frame_yaw before the firmware applies the channel deadband, so the deadband acts in the -45 deg chassis frame; a pure +x command is zeroed below ~0.199 m/s
